newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to aim for flexible economic management--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan to aim for flexible economic management--EPA.

text.p: Japan will work towards appropriate and flexible economic management while keeping careful watch on economic movements, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso said on Thursday.

Japan achieved economic growth of 3.0 percent in the fiscal year ended on March 31, 1997, far above the average forecast by private research institutions of 1.9 percent, Aso told a bankers' convention.
The government had forecast growth of 2.5 percent in gross domestic product (GDP) for 1996/97.
